non sequi: ut, Omnis equus est animal: Nullus
homo est equus: Ergo nullus homo est animal.
Syllogismus (inquies) hic tuus est inconstas &
captiosus. & verissimo contradictionis argumen-
to me conviceris. Ad hoc igitur refellendum, fa-

syllogismorum simplicium figuris, omnia nuga-
rum genera accumulari: In quibus tam consta-
nter acriterque refellendis, sæpe demiratus sum
P. Rami diligentiam atque constantiam, sepeq;

page.notes: Line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 are marginal line markers, not notes. The text is partly faint at the right edge of the column; some readings are uncertain, notably "inst attributum", "nunquam", "commodius", and the words after "quarta quod complexio". The last word "gene-" is a catchword-style hyphenated line end continuing on the next page.
